notes.title: Patch Notes - Hotfix 1.2.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/cad97d7fc13a9e6cac4fc5c2ee2116f7de2812b8.png[/img]
Greetings Survivors!

Hotfix 1.2.5 fixes a few additional bugs that came up over the past week as well as some vendor adjustments for game balancing.

We appreciate everyone that's been submitting reports when you encounter a bug as it's helping us to take action quickly.  Please continue reporting any bugs you encounter at [url=https://forms.gle/zNQ8VhjH7LvvaMt17]https://forms.gle/zNQ8VhjH7LvvaMt17[/url].

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
Fixed an issue causing some people to not be able to log in with steam and being forced to an Epic Games login (Note: If you continue to experience this, please email our support team at support@xeragame.com)

Fixed an issue allowing for floating planter boxes
Fixed an issue allowing more than 20 planter boxes to be placed per land claim

[h3]Vendor Rebalance[/h3]
Seeds can no longer be purchased from a vendor (Note: Seeds are found at the farms location and are fairly common to find)
Increased the selling value for gemstones

[h3]Anti-cheat[/h3]
The use of Bloody software has been blocked due to the ability to abuse the software to gain an unfair advantage through the use of recoil scripts being ingested.  When joining servers, if you are using Bloody hardware, all software associated with Bloody must be closed prior to launching the game.

As a reminder the use of any auto-clicking or macro software to change recoil or fire-rates is prohibited and can lead to account restrictions/bans per the code of conduct which can be found at [url=https://xeragame.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360024225574-Code-Of-Conduct-Game-Community]https://xeragame.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360024225574-Code-Of-Conduct-Game-Community[/url]

[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
We've received reports from some players that the lockpicks ui is not accepting mouse input when trying to use a lockpick (ex. the pick sticks when moving your mouse left and right but doesn't move).  Our team is investigating this issue and we believe it could be related to network lag when using the lockpick or if any game files have been modified.  If you are experiencing this, be sure that you have not modified any game files or changed any keybindings from outside the game.  If you are experiencing high ping, we would recommend seeing if this issue occurs on a server where you get lower ping.  Be sure to send any feedback/reports through the bug report form mentioned above.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Hotfix 1.2.4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/ef6e8f160d9b5ed43a810391f5cd7ce793d99423.png[/img]
Greetings Survivors!

Hotfix 1.2.4 addresses a few bugs that popped up from the last patch.  As this is a small hotfix to address bug fixes we’ll keep things short.

Thank you to everyone that submitted the bug reports and as a reminder, please make sure that you submit any bugs found using the form at [url=https://forms.gle/zNQ8VhjH7LvvaMt17]https://forms.gle/zNQ8VhjH7LvvaMt17[/url] so that we can quickly address any issues that are found.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

Fixed an issue causing some rocks to not be destroyed when hitting them with a pickaxe
Fixed an issue causing some rocks to not drop materials when hitting them with a pickaxe
Fixed an issue with pot campfires not allowing eggs to be put in them.
Added missing pickup button to Water Collectors
Added missing pickup button to Planter Boxes
Fixed a bug causing base floors to collapse when a storage crate or other deployable objects were picked up
Fixed a bug causing eggs to spawn in animal traps instead of rabbit meat
Fixed a bug causing chicken coops to not spawn eggs
Fixed a bug causing the lockpicks UI to sometimes get stuck if multiple lockpicks were being used and the player was experiencing network lag
Fixed a bug causing players near the farms to sometimes spawn under the map.
Fixed a map bug in one area where terrain seams were incorrectly rendering
Fixed a bug causing the map UI to not properly render on low settings

[h3]Known Issues[/h3]

Sometimes when shift dragging items to transfer them to/from a storage container, clicking outside of the Quantity To Transfer box then hitting esc will cause the Quantity To Transfer UI to stick on your screen.  A partial fix has been put in place to allow users to hit Alt+tab  when you are in windowed or borderless windowed mode which will enable you to use your mouse cursor to click on the cancel button to close the UI without needing to restart your game.  A full fix is planned for a future patch.

Auto-running while swimming cases your camera to be in free look and does not allow you to control movement with your mouse.  Keyboard movement still works fine. We recommend not using auto-run while swimming if this is an issue for you as a fix is not planned at the moment.

Picking Algae can sometimes be difficult around the islands - A fix for this is planned in the future.  For now it is suggested to try picking Algae in shallow areas around the islands where the water isn't as deep.  Going into first person by hitting c by default makes this a bit easier.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.2.3 - Islands and Farms Content Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/67e245087be210459a7e6db483eb380fbbef298d.png[/img]
Greetings Survivors!

We’re excited to release patch 1.2.3 - Islands and Farms Update!
In this patch more than 80 new items have been added to the game along with new areas to explore, swimming, new craftables and more!  There have also been quite a few bug fixes in this patch along with some changes to the in game vendors as we continue expanding upon this system.

We have also enabled an XP Boost weekend for this weekend which will run until Monday, August 5th.
All players will receive double xp during this event and season pass holders will receive triple xp.

[h2]Patch Notes 1.2.3[/h2]

[h3]General[/h3]
Modified engine configuration that should help with hitching when levels unload 
Increased max fps (for 'display' option to 500 fps) 
Increased Premium Listing Fee to 100 x-coin for premium listings on the Survivor Exchange (was 25)

[h3]Skins[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/35acead26dc6988f1dcdbd2bd6c69a3b02bbbaae.png[/img]
Added new country helmet skins to the in game cosmetics shop
Implemented helmet skins in game (There will be an additional assortment released on the Season 8 Season Pass)

[h3]Lockpicking[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/b546ac87d2436fd9529f66e184e0ba5a7b48c994.png[/img]
New lockpick system implemented, some objects will now require the lockpick item to unlock ATMs now require lockpick, difficulty is scaled by how much cash it contains (Jackpot being highest difficulty) 
Safes now require lockpick, difficulty is scaled by how much cash it contains (Jackpot being highest difficulty)
New treasure chests found at island bandit camps will require lockpicks
[b]Lockpicking is done by moving your mouse to the left or right, then hold a to attempt to pick the lock as shown in the video below.[/b]
[h3][/h3]
[previewyoutube=CW2pStN_BwI;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/7d5169a725fe8277501cb5d8294923211548a33a.png[/img]

[h3]Swimming/Rivers/Lakes[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/f8cf5ab2b6ba1ddbfedf75b2e42a9c8f8e24e3b5.png[/img]
Added new swimming system allowing players to swim in water unlocking the new island areas to be explored
[b]Vehicles can no longer enter water and will explode if they do so[/b]

[h3]UI[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/18f698fb0eafe281ec99f8a8f90cea4318ed8cba.png[/img]
Added 'Press E to loot all' from containers 
Ping on map UI will now use assigned 'ping' keybind instead of middle mouse button 
Improved helicopter transporter UI 
Changed 'refresh' button on server list to be refreshable every 1s 
Added current weather conditions to HUD
Removed decimal from ping location indicator 
Fixed an issue that caused hair to clip through helmets in inventory preview
Updated vendor UI
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/83ad0bc584d37c0ce3d138fd987c5913cdca74d3.png[/img]

[h3]Map Updates[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/0865a3ceab409f46b2c12e5162c8c99e5a7de3ac.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/6222661cf9af2f66ad30dea15975099659c82b64.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/96d3b98d315899eafaaf96cd5d517107c93ec13a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/f4473f71e39edcd2e076194f25dead50fd568344.png[/img]
New islands have been released along with bandit compounds full of loot and heavily guarded
Farms area has been completely revamped with it’s own special loot table for the farms
Base building has been blocked around bridges - This was necessary with the vehicles being updated to no longer be able to be driven through water as was mentioned in a previous announcement.  [b]Bases that are currently blocking bridges are subject to removal by the admin team as prior notice was given that these bases would no longer be allowed[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/b350abf4656bef47172ff644660bbf021ae0cce8.png[/img]

[h3]Turrets[/h3]
Adjusted damage multiplier from 0.2 to 0.15 (making them slightly harder to destroy)

[h3]In Game Vendors[/h3]
Fixed a bug that was causing vendors to under pay for some items that are not sold by the vendor normally
Added vendor prices to all new items
Increased the price vendors pay for Meteorite Dust ([b]Note: this is a temporary change as Meteorite Dust will be used for weapon upgrading in the future[/b])
Added crops and seeds to the vendors for purchasing ([b]Note: not all crops and seeds can be bought from a vendor and some must be found at the new farms area[/b])
Added higher level weapons to the vendor ([b]Note: the price displayed in the vendor is the base price for that weapon, and the final price is dependent upon your character’s level and the rarity level of the weapon being purchased[/b])

[h3]New Items[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/a290e2c6b2e0f1e762f6abc5e17766cd6e880412.png[/img]
Added 30 different crops and 30 different crop seeds that can be grown using planting boxes - These can be found at the Farms - [b]Note: Crops that are being grown will have their progress reset on server restarts.  As this is still experimental, we will be looking at a solution to this in the future.[/b]
Added new craftable items including Planter Box, Beehives, Chicken Coop, Barbed Wire traps, and Landmines
Added Base Lights in an assortment of colors
Added new food items including fried egg, crops that can be grown and consumed, and more
Added Coral, Sponges, and Seaweed that can be found in the ocean areas
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/e2522c0e11c6e769cc8158bb6c066aea68aabc08.png[/img]

[h3]Weapons[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/eb9266313560a0167973ef42c0d1f50c099fbd1d.png[/img]
Added knife melee weapon

[h3]Vehicles[/h3]
[b]Vehicles can no longer be driven through water and will be destroyed upon entering water[/b]
Adjusted AMV physics collisions
Added vehicle spawn to prison
Implemented fix to help with vehicle spawning under the map on map load
Fixed an issue with player exit location on disconnect / force client close
Fixed ATV Storage 
Fixed AMV Storage 
Fixed Buggy Storage
Added Horn rebind option to settings menu

[h3]Wildlife/Animals[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/757156846ecc88f37f1def0584c5d33e62a1351c.png[/img]
Added farm animals to the farms area - Note: This is experimental and more wildlife is planned to be added to other areas of the map in the future.
Improved the AI system for wildlife

[h3]Crafting[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/5bec7629f760e8fc0596969ea62306dbb5a59aef.png[/img]
Added ability to add favorite recipes
Added crafting recipes for Planter Box, Beehive, Chicken Coop, Barbed Wire Traps, Base Lights, Landmines, and more!

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
Fixed an issue causing some overlapping of base parts as well as floating parts in some edge cases. Note: This is experimental and we still have more work being done to prevent players from being able to stack walls and doors against each other for base building
Fixed an issue where vendors were not paying the proper amount for items
Fixed an issue causing players that are disconnected while in a vehicle to be spawned under the map
Fixed an issue with storage on vehicles

We appreciate your support and look forward to moving towards Season 8 which should be coming in a short few weeks along with launching on the Epic Games Store!  As always, feel free to reach out to us in our discord at https://discord.gg/xera
[h3][/h3]
As a reminder, we count on the community to report any bugs that you may find.  If you encounter any bugs please submit a bug report form at [url=https://forms.gle/zNQ8VhjH7LvvaMt17]https://forms.gle/zNQ8VhjH7LvvaMt17[/url] and be sure to provide as much detail as possible along with screenshots and/or video that will help us with fixing any bugs that may pop up.

notes.title: Important Announcement - Upcoming Map Changes, No Build Zones, and EOS
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/a4c96956eecb723f03ed230db632d1d274792fbe.png[/img]
Greetings Survivors,
We have an important announcement regarding no-build zones.

The upcoming patch has 7 additional "no build zones", if you have a base in these areas it is recommend that you move it before the patch is deployed.

This is due to bridges becoming choke-points, as vehicles will not be able to enter water, and the terrain has been lowered along the rivers in preparation for the new swimming mechanic.   Highlighted below are the areas that will no longer be build-able zones after the next patch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/b350abf4656bef47172ff644660bbf021ae0cce8.png[/img]

We usually only make changes to no build zones and terrain between seasons to avoid this issue, but since we are near the end of the season - this change is coming into effect.

We are wrapping up testing and completing the next patch and anticipate the next patch will be released later this week.

With the release of the upcoming Farms and Islands Patch, and in preparation for enabling cross-play with users from the Epic Games Store and migration to EOS Anti-Cheat, we have also created an FAQ regarding the integration of Epic Online Services which will be a requirement for the game to function going forward.  

[h3]Rest assured we have made this a seamless process and we want to assure our players that an Epic Games account [b]is not required[/b] in order to play the game through steam.[/h3]

Information regarding the integration of EOS can be found at [url=https://xeragame.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/34903142066201-Epic-Online-Services-Epic-Games-Store-FAQ]https://xeragame.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/34903142066201-Epic-Online-Services-Epic-Games-Store-FAQ[/url]

Regards,
Spotted Kiwi

notes.title: Season 7 Devblog - Map Changes & More!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/fdb7eb455e48ed68c2c24057f0d8051b4678b628.png[/img]

Greetings Survivors!  

We wanted to share some updates on what’s been happening behind the scenes as it’s been a couple of weeks since the last dev blog!  We’ll keep it short and sweet, but a ton of progress has been made and we’re excited to release the next update soon!  Here’s a quick look at what we’ve been up to!

[h2]Swimming[/h2]
Testing and progress on the new swimming system has just about wrapped up and we are planning for this to be released in the next patch.  We’ve worked on polishing the swim mechanic as well as drowning out a few pesky bugs that came up during testing over the past week!  With the release of swimming, you’ll be able to access the expanded island areas of the map which will provide players with new areas to explore and build their bases.  We’ve also implemented new items including sea sponges, coral, and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/23d9964758e35534f99b447586871712a20e53a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/b01ed555805f8e6d2ad8c07b777dbdd084f3b35d.png[/img]

[h2]Map Updates[/h2]
As was mentioned in the previous dev blog, several map updates have been ongoing and we anticipate them being released with the next patch.  Here’s a few sneak peaks of some of the island areas that were recently polished, along with Bakersfield Farms which was featured during our developer streams this week.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/6222661cf9af2f66ad30dea15975099659c82b64.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/f4473f71e39edcd2e076194f25dead50fd568344.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/394ab7ee426fb0211ad89068dbacf84848333f6d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/0b26d3ce9b7f1d207ce9eb7759c545e1f5d690df.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/08306d507ac4855e7acc794b9301c69f67012c88.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/b4f6fe81647d6720c58b722534b6b4f6e245af6d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/878012d0b11e8e23f07f477747035d03681489ac.png[/img]
[h2]Snow Weather Update[/h2]
We have also updated the snow system in game adding new textures to really bring the world alive during the cold seasons.  Here’s a couple of sneak peaks from the farms during snowy conditions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/1fc30ca6096760f75fef0a1f95274d7000ed2bb0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/e6808558c54ad545b1aed05ac1795c4b0f1651cd.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/4519d89b66838e4a6b5248940533e3954553697f.png[/img]
[h2]Helmet Skins[/h2]
We’ve also been working on the helmet cosmetics system. Which will be available in this next update, country themed helmet skins will be available in the shop. Let us know what country you would like to see!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/07a39a27806475308a3eb9ee1ac09dda85217d37.png[/img]

We hope that you have enjoyed reading about all of the exciting things that are coming soon and look forward to reading your feedback.  Remember, as a community driven game, we count on everyone for your feedback and suggestions as we expand the content available to all of our players.  Feel free to connect with us via our discord at [url=https://discord.gg/xera]https://discord.gg/xera[/url] and let us know your thoughts!

Cheers,
Spotted Kiwi Interactive

notes.title: Season 7 Devblog - Farming & Islands
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/dba7a3e3677f4d524710308526ff64e33b345690.png[/img]

Greetings Survivors!  We want to thank everyone for the tremendous amount of support for the launch of XERA: Survival Season 7!  And To all of the new players joining us, welcome and we can’t wait to meet each of you in game and through our official discord!  With the release of the long anticipated wipe and Season 7, we’ve seen a large growth in returning players and new players coming in and we hope you’re enjoying the fresh start along with the populated servers!

As we continue throughout Season 7 we have a lot of new content planned which we want to share with everyone through this Dev Blog.  Keep in mind that not everything we are working on will be included here, but we want to share some of the upcoming content being developed and gather your thoughts and feedback as well!  With that being said, let’s get straight into a deep dive of some of the exciting things coming throughout the next few weeks!

[h2]Swimming[/h2]
The addition of a swimming mechanic will open up new areas of the map, along with scattered islands around the edges of the map. This will also introduce choke points on bridges (These will become no-build zones) as vehicles will not be able to traverse through the water. A number of islands will be available to build on along with the addition of palm trees for wood gathering in these areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/247e5216e128a9e9eece10560d122b31f61a0580.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/9de70885b4dc931eebf4c97a143ecd4abec0d01e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/f8cf5ab2b6ba1ddbfedf75b2e42a9c8f8e24e3b5.png[/img]
[h2]Wildlife/Animals[/h2]
The introduction of more wildlife into the game will add a new dynamic. We’ve also improved the AI (which was previously used with the Deer at the Southern Lakes) to make them feel more natural. New mechanics include, fleeing when attacked, becoming aggressive towards threats, including players and other wildlife in the area. Currently we plan to introduce a variety of new animals including Cows, Chickens, Wolves, Bears, and Pigs in addition to the deer that are already in the game. Wildlife will also be harvest-able for their meat and other materials which will be used for new cooking and crafting recipes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/d023e8d38790d4ce9c68f5d3431e0bcc24375783.png[/img]
[h2]Map Updates[/h2]
In the next update you will notice a few changes to the map, firstly beaches will have harvestable palm trees, which grant wood, plant fibers and a chance of coconuts. We are also re-working Bakersfield Farms to feel more natural and with a lot more loot - tied into a ‘Farming’ loot table for seeds and other items for the new farming system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/acc76c3c4d25ca58e634a9793a6836ebd5c407e3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/1bfe2dda132b35ba0b530af919f32aad9fd92c5f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/3370f043a7104baf4d07a0909a378f790af017d3.png[/img]
[h2]Base Building/Farming Updates[/h2]
We are also working on a brand new farming system, allowing you to grow a range of 30 different crops. Along with crop growing and harvesting, we are also introducing bee hives for collecting honey, a chicken coop for eggs, and the water harvester for filling bottles. We are also adding base lights which will be craftable to allow for lighting in darker conditions as this has been a highly requested feature from the community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/a290e2c6b2e0f1e762f6abc5e17766cd6e880412.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/8fe9775c5cd92c3c69623951bf1f9794277e3a69.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/7e06b4fba4a001e30a7d65c02ec341d17df03bd2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/7b08115be1b312db6361ca503853355f52948a30.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/71a1bf5fcf2faf40ed4942a11fb2effdc58736fc.png[/img]
[h2]Crafting/Cooking[/h2]
As we have added a number of new food items, new recipes and cooking of these items will be available. We have added a new ‘pot campfire’ which will be used for these new recipes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/c114c23e879bc00e1c404595d9cb8e58e0538ec4.png[/img]
[h2]Crafting Menu[/h2]
As the game has expanded to include a lot more crafting options, we have added the ability to favorite recipes - making it a lot easier to access your frequently crafted items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/8c6e309d046faa9238ed08b1196f75e3e6969db3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/6e68e0fb1ea670d0152b562cc80502db5528432f.png[/img]

We hope that you have enjoyed reading about all of the exciting things that are coming soon and look forward to reading your feedback.  Remember, as a community driven game, we count on everyone for your feedback and suggestions as we expand the content available to all of our players.  Feel free to connect with us via our discord at https://discord.gg/xera and let us know your thoughts!

Cheers,
Spotted Kiwi Interactive

notes.title: Season 7 Begins Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/67324d4ea880e0833fcc633cd2cb3d1bcf03e3a4.png[/img]
[h2]🎉 Welcome to Season 7 of XERA: Survival! 🎉[/h2]

Season 7 brings a plethora of updates and new features, including the introduction of an Armored Vehicle, improved AI behaviors, enhanced visual and sound effects, and numerous fixes. Dive into the exciting new content and experience a more immersive and challenging survival adventure!

[h3]General[/h3]
Various fixes to help resolve getting stuck on 'Loading Levels'
New hit-marker icon for hitting headshots
New hit-marker icon for hitting vehicles
New hit-marker icon for hitting base parts

[h3]Vehicle[/h3]
New vehicle - 5 Person Armoured Vehicle (AMV)

[h3]Main Menu[/h3]
Daily rewards now accessible through the main menu

[h3]FX[/h3]
New Impact FX for Concrete
New Impact FX for Sand
New Impact FX for Grass
New Impact FX for Metal
New Decal System On Impact

[h3]Sounds[/h3]
New AK-47 Firing Audio
New UMP Firing Audio
New G-17 Firing Audio
New Deagle Firing Audio
New L96-A1 Firing Audio
New 1911 Firing Audio
New SVD Firing Audio
New Scar-H/L Firing Audio
New M16 Firing Audio
New MP5 Firing Audio
New AKS Firing Audio
New AR-15 Firing Audio
New G3A3 Firing Audio
New G36 Firing Audio
Fixed an issue with G3A3 reload sound not being attenuated

[h3]UI[/h3]
Land Claim location will now display on the map
Added UI indicator on current item smelting in furnaces
New UI indicator when in range of a workbench

[h3]Items[/h3]
Renamed 'Mushroom' to 'Red Mushroom'
Added Blue Mushroom
Added Yellow Mushroom
Added Purple Mushroom
Added Metorite Dust (created by adding Meteorite Rocks and Reactor Material to a Refinery)

[h3]Bandits[/h3]
Bandit characters will use the character system (Random outfits given)
Increased spawn rate of bandits
Added hit-box multipliers (Head-shot/Body)
Added impact effects
Improved AI general behavior
Bandits will now shoot vehicles if a player is in it or if it's blocking their line of sight to the player

[h3]XOIDs[/h3]
XOIDs will now attack vehicles if the player is driving or standing inside

[h3]Resources[/h3]
Picking mushrooms now grants a random mushroom type (Red, Blue, Yellow, Purple)

[h3]Radio Towers[/h3]
Air Drop on completion will spawn within 350 meters of the radio tower

[h3]Air Drops[/h3]
Air drops will randomly deploy on the map every 30 minutes

[h3]Base Building[/h3]
Furnace, Metal Press, and Refinery will now process one slot at a time
Changed max slots of Furnace to 8
Changed max slots of Metal Press to 8
Changed max slots of Refinery to 8
Changed max stack of Furnace to 25
Changed max stack of Metal Press to 8
Changed max stack of Refinery to 8
Changed turret receiving damage multiplier from 0.1 to 0.2 for bullets
Fixed an issue causing floating bases when doors/windows are used
Fixed an issue with Furnace giving more resources than expected
Fixed an issue with Metal Press giving more resources than expected
Fixed an issue with Refinery giving more resources than expected
Increased the HP of Wood Foundations from 750 to 1500
Increased the HP of Stone Foundations from 1500 to 3000
Increased the HP of Metal Foundations from 2600 to 5000
Increased the HP of Reinforced Metal Foundations from 3200 to 7500

[b]Note with the changes to the smelting process, it is important that you leave 1 to 2 slots open when smelting materials in a Furnace, Metal Press, or Refinery.  Ideally you should use 1 slot for the fuel source and 3-4 slots max for materials being smelted.  This allows resources to be outputted to one of the remaining slots.  If all slots are filled, your fuel will still be consumed, and nothing will be output as it requires an open slot.[/b]

[h3]Missions[/h3]
Moved Sleepy Time and A Good Night's Rest missions to be in the same track as placing a base foundation
Added tooltip text to indicate that a sleeping bag will appear on the map

[h3]Vendor[/h3]
Added Buy Values to Vendor for Blue Mushroom, Yellow Mushroom, Purple Mushroom, and Meteorite Dust

[h3]Global Stash[/h3]
Removed Reactor Material from Global Stash
Removed Wires from Global Stash
Removed Alcohol from Global Stash
Removed Epoxy Resin from Global Stash
Removed Batteries from Global Stash

Dive into the new season and explore all the fantastic updates we've rolled out. Your feedback is invaluable to us, so keep it coming. Let's survive and thrive together in XERA: Survival!

Happy gaming!
The XERA: Survival Team

We also would like to share the following development update from Joshua and invite you to share your feedback by filling out our feedback survey at https://forms.gle/h3YuECUb3SbU7jp76

[h3]A message from Joshua[/h3]
Greetings everyone!

I want to take a moment to express my deepest gratitude to all of you who have shown unwavering support throughout the incredible journey of XERA: Survival. It has been an amazing yet challenging path for us, with a small team dedicated to its development over many years. We are fully aware of your passion for the game and your desire for a promising future.

We understand that it has been a considerable amount of time since the last content update or the introduction of a new season. Unfortunately, various factors have contributed to this situation. However, despite these challenges, the Spotted Kiwi team has remained committed to closely monitoring the game. We have allocated our resources to ensure that the servers remain available, diligently addressed reports, and taken measures against cheaters to maintain a fair and enjoyable gameplay experience for everyone.

Given the constraints imposed by our limited resources, our initial focus will be on implementing a forthcoming wipe. This wipe will impact both PVP and PVE servers. Our intention is to establish realistic expectations as we progress with our development efforts. While major updates may not be feasible at this time, please know that we are dedicated to delivering quality of life updates that enhance your overall gameplay experience.  Although we do not have an estimate on when the next wipe will occur, we will be posting an announcement at least 1 week prior to the wipe happening so that everyone can prepare for it.

Looking ahead, it's important to acknowledge that Spotted Kiwi has its limitations when it comes to the content we can implement in the game. Your input and feedback truly matter to us, and we want to focus on what matters most to you as we explore the way forward.

Today, we are reaching out to you, our incredible players, to gather your valuable feedback regarding the future of XERA: Survival. We genuinely appreciate your insights and opinions. If you can spare a moment, we kindly request that you share your thoughts through this feedback form: https://forms.gle/h3YuECUb3SbU7jp76

Thank you for being an integral part of this journey with us. Your support and dedication mean the world to our team.

-Joshua

notes.title: Season 6 Begins Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/988d30de25f7170c0a72430dcd01c6363c458a4c.png[/img]
Greetings Survivors!

We appreciate your patience as we completed the transition between seasons!  We are excited to announce that Season 6 is now available and patch 1.1 is now available to download!

With the release of Season 6, there have been massive changes to the way base raiding and looting works.  All weapons now have a specific weapon level assign which will determine the damage output for each gun.  The higher the weapon level, the more base damage it is capable of doing!  For raiding, we have also introduced a stability system to allow for easier raiding along with other balancing.

There's so much to talk about, for this season and we have a ton more to come.  Be sure to check out the patch notes below for all of the changes that have been made for the start of the new season.

For Season 6, please be sure that if you encounter any bugs that they are immediately reported to staff via the following link - [url=https://forms.gle/zNQ8VhjH7LvvaMt17]https://forms.gle/zNQ8VhjH7LvvaMt17[/url].  For all bug reports, please ensure you are providing video, screenshots, and steps to reproduce the bug so that our team can quickly reproduce and fix it.  [b]Do not spread information regarding bugs you encounter as we want to fix any bugs that might be abused to ensure that everyone is playing fair.[/b]

As always, thank you for your support and feel free to reach out to our team via our official discord at [url=https://discord.gg/xera]https://discord.gg/xera[/url].

Welcome to XERA: Survival Season 6!

[h1][b]Patch 1.1 Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
AFK Timer added to kick players from server for inactivity after 5 minutes 
Respawn timer fixed for groups with more than 4 players

[h3][b]Player Respawn System[/b][/h3]
Nearby spawns will now check if a player is within 100m of that spawn location and will find the next nearest spawn point if that player is not in your clan
Spawn protection will now clear when entering a vehicle
Spawn protection will now clear when an item is picked up off the ground

[h3][b]Audio[/b][/h3]
Helicopter audio can now be controlled from the “Vehicle Volume” setting

[b]NOTE: Please be careful leaving this volume too low, as it does also control ATVs/Buggies volume[/b]

[h3][b]Weapons & Equipment[/b][/h3]
XOID Core damage multiplier increased to 3x
XOID Body damage multiplier increased to 1.75x
Player Headshot damage multiplier decreased to 4.5x
EMP Grenade now disables turrets for 45 seconds (was 15)
Xoidite Explosive damage increased to 500 HP (was 300 HP)

[h3][b]Vehicles[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Community Poll - Changes to wipes!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/a4c96956eecb723f03ed230db632d1d274792fbe.png[/img]
Hello Survivors,

We are currently discussing internally about wipes and how often they should be. There’s a few reasons to wipe more frequently and typically we would only wipe between seasons.

Obviously sometimes seasons can last more than 2 months - and we want the game to remain fresh for all players. There are some things to take into consideration including, which progress to wipe and looking after our PVE players where wipes don’t really affect them as much.

We wanted to reach out and get some feedback on how wiping will look in the future. Firstly I’d like to explain the types of wipes.

[h3][b]Types of Wipes:[/b][/h3]
[b]Soft-wipe[/b]
[list]
[*] All servers (Except PVE) wiped of all structures and claims
[*] All items from Global Stash removed
[*] All items from Survivor Exchange removed
[*] Characters Items Removed (Except PVE characters)
[*] Currency Reset (Includes PVE Players)
[*] Missions Reset
[/list]

[b]Hard-Wipe (Season Start Only)[/b]
[list]
[*] All servers (Including PVE) wiped of all structures claims
[*] Levels / Currency / Experience / Stats / Character Items Reset
[*] All items removed from Global Stash
[*] All items removed from Survivor Exchange 
[*] Missions Reset
[/list]
[h3][b]Here are the options we have discussed internally:[/b][/h3]
[olist]
[*] Soft-wipe (except PVE) before the first weekend of every month
[*] Soft-wipe (except PVE) before the first weekend of every second month
[*] Hard-wipe Only (Keep wipes the way they are at the start of every season)
[/olist]
We have created a poll which we would like the community to vote on. 

Please place your vote here: https://strawpoll.com/1z9rrf44a

You can also suggest more ideas regarding wipes in our discord (https://discord.gg/xera) in the #suggestions-ideas channel.

Regards,
Spotted Kiwi

notes.title: XERA: Survival Patch 1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/e09b652cdf8dcba241e68bb6205b355043334020.png[/img]

Greetings Survivors!

Patch 1.0.3 addresses a few issues with the land claim system, these changes will help with new players finding land a lot easier. The changes also prevent players from expanding their base beyond the base radius. We've also made authorising your clan on an existing land claim much easier. Clan and group members now have access to dismantle inside of a land claim (So be careful who you group with and invite into your clan). There has been some optimisations done to the vehicle props found in cities/towns - which should help a lot with FPS and loading inside of those areas. There has also been some balancing done to the helicopter transport - based off player feedback we have reduced the speed of sky-diving and reduced the height of which the helicopter hovers above the map. Various bugs have also been fixed with the vehicles. There is now a health UI for objects such as storage and turrets, and health is now transferred to item durability when picked up - to stop players dismantling and then replacing objects to get them full health again.

We appreciate everyone's feedback and please continue to report any issues you encounter by submitting a bug form at https://forms.gle/zNQ8VhjH7LvvaMt17.

Distance between land claims has now been reduced to 150m (was 200m)

You can no longer dismantle a land claim while there are objects inside

notes.title: XERA: Survival Patch 1.0 Release Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/35f39ebcd4ef05c1a913fb86c3b9b751f551efd8.png[/img]
Welcome to Season 5 survivors! We would like to extend our gratitude for all the support during Season 4 and our F2P transition. We’ve recently hit a massive milestone of 275,000 players and it’s been an amazing journey for the team.  With the release of Patch 1.0, XERA: Survival will be moving out of early access.  This patch represents the hard work our team has put in over the past few years and we’re excited to release some of the most requested features from our community into the game with this patch.

[h2][b]Leaving Early Access[/b][/h2]

XERA: Survival has been in Early Access since May 2019, we’ve changed, grown and improved the game - as well grown a lot as a small indie studio. Originally starting as a team of one in 2016 - XERA was a dream that would not have been possible without all of you.

Over the last few years we have implemented most of the core mechanics that we as a studio wanted in the game and also a lot of content which was requested by the community. We’ve also greatly increased the quality of the game, and we feel that XERA: Survival is ready to make its move out of early access. 

Two years ago we implemented the seasons system - which has allowed us to ultimately change many aspects of the game - providing new content as well as fresh servers for players to experience the game again with different balancing aspects. The season system also allows us to plan content accordingly based on feedback from the community and implement those changes into the next season. Our transition out of early access does not mean that this will be the final content patch, rather it is a new beginning as we plan to bring even more to XERA: Survival in the future.  Our team is committed to delivering regular updates for the game throughout each new season as well as new and exciting features that have not been implemented during our time in Early Access.

[h2][b]Patch 1.0 Release Notes[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Clan System[/b][/h3]
Creating a clan allows you to build with other players, and allows you to share land claim permissions with them. When you place a land claim, anyone in your clan will be able to build inside your claimed land. You will also be able to build inside their claimed land. Your clan tag will display on your character nametag and inside the player menu. The default maximum size of a clan is 10, with the option to increase slots through upgrades and the premium clan option. Premium Clan's also have access to more tag color options. The option for upgrading clan slots will be implemented in the future. The clan system is still experimental - so there are some things that are subject to change.

Clan members can upgrade/place inside the clans claim, but the land claim owner will still be the only one who can destroy objects there. This is going to be adjusted based on player feedback in the next updates. 

You cannot currently modify the clan tag or name after creating a clan. This is going to be added in one of the next patches. So if you are making a clan please ensure you select a name and tag carefully.

[i][b]Important Note: If you place a land claim before making or joining a clan and want clan members to build in your land claim - you can dismantle your claim and replace it to activate the clan permissions. The same applies to turrets - you will need to pick up and place turrets again to ensure they have the clan permissions.[/b][/i]

[h3][b]Character Preview[/b][/h3]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/abcb24029eabbf0cfd46f4fb73d9e93dbce60554.png[/img]
Greetings Survivors!

Patch 9.4.3 implements several suggestions based on community feedback as well as some minor bug fixes.  As Season 4 is coming to a close soon, we have implemented the option for players who have not completed their premium season pass to be able to purchase the remaining levels they would like to unlock.  Each level costs 250 X-Coin to unlock and will grant the rewards on the Season Pass for that level.  Purchasing Season Pass levels does not impact your in game player level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/910d1e120ddf7e9c7829f958524fdcd1e92742f5.png[/img]

To purchase each level you would like to unlock, click on the Season Pass button from the main menu.  This will bring up your current Season Pass and show you the progress you have made throughout Season 4.  To purchase an unlock for the next Season Pass reward, click on the Purchase level button and that level's reward will then be unlocked for you to claim.  Level boosts that have been purchased will be shown under your player level on the Season Pass UI.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/c8ef560a5450ec9a1ae25ab101cca03952c0dcc5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/f86322bfd6f90d1050bf7bfe81b33a6280f03b7b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/09cb87b41c08b802bce0caecbe062396c0edc032.png[/img]

One of the biggest pieces of feedback from players we've seen has been the request for ways to access roofs that can be jumped on top of from the helicopter transport.  To help with balancing roof camping, various buildings throughout the towns have had fire escapes added which will allow players to push others that might be holding down the roof of a building.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/9ae1ae64777161898296fab93e740290d1cf3f9a.png[/img]

Finally, we have decided to extend last weekend's 2x/3x XP Boost Event until the end of Season 4 to help everyone achieve level 100!

As always we appreciate all of the support and feedback the community has shown.  For the latest, be sure to join our discord where we have started previewing new content coming for Season 5. We will also be providing updates regarding the start date and time for the new season, which is set to be this weekend!

notes.title: XERA: Survival Early Access Patch 9.4 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/af14c7c99c6d6e0938694fd7c7d0d5606b8518ab.png[/img]
Greetings Survivors!

Patch 9.4 introduces the all new Survivor Exchange!  The Survivor Exchange allows players to buy and sell in game items from other players without having to be online.  This functions by using your global inventory and allows you to list any item that is currently in your global inventory for sale.  Once the item has been listed, the item is removed from your global stash and placed on the marketplace.  Items you purchase from the survivor exchange will automatically be stored in your global inventory and you can retrieve them once you re-join any server.  The Survivor Exchange is available to all players once they have reached level 15 in game. 

[b]Developer Note:  Items purchased on the survivor exchange can only be used on servers that have the Global Inventory available.  PVE servers are not able to have access to items that are stored in the Global Inventory, thus items purchased from the Survivor Exchange may not be retrieved on PVE only servers.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/0e26a609353a1d1e65df641d75d4973823ff1e7b.png[/img]
From the main menu, access the Survivor Exchange by clicking on Survivor Exchange at the top of the main menu screen.  Clicking on Browse Items will bring up a listing of all items available for sale on the Survivor Exchange.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/4f12d030df0b3c580781c6505320d214b21c0a45.png[/img]
When purchasing an item from the Survivor Exchange, a confirmation box will appear along with the item details.  Item listings are sold by bundles so if there are 75 of an item in the bundle, the price listed is for all 75 of that item.  Bundles [b]can not[/b] be split apart so when listing items for sale, keep in mind the price you list an item for is for the entire amount of that item, that you are offering for sale.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/fa9381cad5875522d2569fb83d958cbfa5e6f30f.png[/img]
To list an item for sale, click on the list item for sale button.  This will display all items available in your global inventory.  The number of items you are allowed to list is based on your player level starting with 10 listings at level 15.  Each time you level up, an additional slot will be available for an additional listing.  When listing items, a 10% fee of the listing price is applied to the item listing and will be deducted from your in-game currency upon listing your item for sale on the Survivor Exchange.  Upgraded premium listings will be highlighted in gold and do not have any listing fees for placing the item for sale on the Survivor Exchange.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/66db0b67a8abeb4df457b0dab4e5ea52c473e464.png[/img]
Click on an item to bring up the list item screen where you will input the quantity you want to sell of that item, and the price you want to charge.  [b]As a reminder, the price you list for your listing is for the entire quantity you are offering of that item and is [i][b]NOT[/b][/i] the price per item.  Ensure you double check that the price you want to charge for the listing is for the entire quantity and not just for 1 of that item. Listing fees are non-refundable once your listing has been posted so be sure to double check everything before offering your items for sale.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/177a4b7e8d8abb76acd02896376535a0f980adfc.png[/img]
Clicking on sold Items will show you items that you have listed and sold on the Survivor Exchange.  To claim the cash from the sale of the items, you will click on the complete button.  Once you have completed the transaction, the amount earned from the sale of your item will be credited to your in game currency balance.  [b]Items can not be purchased or sold for X-Coin, only in game currency.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/97a44288ad361ec786efadebc5674b1a43e486b0.png[/img]
Clicking on the purchased items button will allow you to see your purchase history for all items purchased from the Survivor Exchange.

We know this has been a long awaited feature and we're excited to finally be able to bring the Survivor Exchange to the game. [b]Developer Note:  We are aware that items purchased from the survivor exchange can cause you to go over your available weight in your global inventory.  This is intended for the time being and may change in the future.[/b]

[h2][b]Patch Notes 9.4[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Survivor Exchange[/b][/h3]
Implemented new survivor exchange peer-to-peer marketplace.  This can be accessed by clicking Survivor Exchange from the main menu and utilizes your global inventory for item transfers.

[h3][b]Basebuilding[/b][/h3]
Reduced the number of rocks required for upgrading all base parts to stone tier.

[h3][b]Streamer Mode[/b][/h3]
Streamer mode now masks the player's name when opening their player inventory.

notes.title: Season 4 Release Notes - Season 4 begins now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/54d5259770f1c439e7c55de4026705fc5a0cd93a.png[/img]
Greetings Survivors!

First things first, we want to thank you so much for being patient while we worked towards the release of Season 4.  As a community you guys have been absolutely amazing during this time and it means a lot to the team.  As of the release of these patch notes, we are still waiting for the full transition to free to play and the moment free to play has been enabled for our store page, we will be granting all owners of the game the founder’s package.  We currently have an open ticket for Steam to enable free to play and are hopeful that it should be enabled within the next few days.  While we wait for F2P to be enabled we are running a final 90% sale for anyone that wants to jump in early!

[h2]Base Building[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/d0191426f10070a17a39849dfbb08a0b31503e3d.png[/img]
One of the biggest new features coming for Season 4 is our new base building system!

Our base building design will require resource gathering, which means we have implemented a destructible environment system that will allow for the gathering of wood, rocks, and other resources. By default Unreal Engine does not support this very well so in order to achieve a destructible environment that will scale to the size of our new map (64km2), we had to modify the engine. Resources that have been harvested will respawn after a certain amount of time, and regions on the map will be specialized in certain resources that are generated within each area.

Wood can be harvested from trees with an axe, boulders can be harvested for ores and rocks with a pickaxe. A furnace is used to smelt ores into bars, which then can be used to craft other items or upgrade your base, or be sold to the vendor.

We’ve overhauled our placement system which was previously used for other deployables such as sandbags and turrets. The new system includes a snapping system, which allows for base parts to easily snap together.

Each base part will have individual health and will need to be maintained as bases decay over time. Base parts are also individually upgradable, with 3 tiers - Wood, Stone and Metal.

The base building system is separated by two separate types of components, base parts and perimeter parts. Base parts, such as foundations, walls, floors are used to create your base. The perimeter parts, such as walls and gates are used to surround your base to add extra protection. 

Other objects such as storage containers, work benches, and more will also be available to place inside and around your base. Defense objects, such as punji sticks can also be used to protect your base against raiders.

[b][i]Note: At the time of this release we have disabled base decay while the system is being debugged.  We plan to release the decay system very soon in an upcoming patch.[/i][/b]

[h2]New Map[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/02d40b15e30e8511baa7ed189de789f0d99c65b0.png[/img]
Complete with newly designed towns, a destructible environment, and other points of interest, our new 64km sq map provides players with plenty of opportunity to claim a portion as their new home!  All points of interest have been completely designed from the ground up to give players plenty of new areas to explore as well as provide for intense pvp combat situations.  Our loot tables have been redesigned and implemented to specific containers to allow for a wide variety of different loot types to be found throughout the map.  Military areas are protected by XOIDS and contain opportunities for high tier gear to spawn, but be prepared, the XOIDS have become stronger than their previous humanoid counterparts!  With global events spawning throughout the map, there’s always going to be something happening and you never know when you might run across someone’s base!  Be prepared, gear up, and discover the world!

[h2]Character Customization[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/6f0650e7e1ac3eed81a86bac2b7a85841af8d328.png[/img]
Hey good lookin! Season 4 brings one of the most anticipated and requested features, character customization. Customize your character to your own groovy style, or go for that rugged look!  The choice is yours!  Our character customization system includes 2 different body types, an assortment of skin tones to choose from, tons of hair styles, facial hair, and a full palette of hair colors to give you a unique look from others in the game!  Upon your first time logging in, you’ll be prompted to create your character’s appearance.  We have also included in game character clothing that can be earned by progressing through the Season Pass!  What’s your style?

[h2]Missions System[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/20a2f80e38789fd49ccd6613f9078ba3564f2811.png[/img]
With the release of Season 4 comes our all new Campaign Missions!  The campaign missions will be a progressive system, which will allow players to be introduced to in-game mechanics, as well as reward them with in-game gear and more. Campaign missions will start out very simple and increase in difficulty as you progress from one tier to the next.  With over 70 different missions to complete, you’ll always have a goal to work towards!  We have plans for additional missions in the future as we work on expanding this system even further.

[h2]Season Pass/X-Coins[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/9fd01041d748c0878a97b53e0fa7992a599b5bd4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/db35abae516ab9ac2a833d895fa5e107664f0b8a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/cdf9aedf04af998b5bb931c7f742409dd252eb87.png[/img]
Season 4 will include our all new Season Pass and Premium Season Pass available to all players.  The Season Pass will be tied to the player’s character level and offers a vast assortment of cosmetics, weapon skin crates, and more!  Rewards will be granted to all Free-to-play players every few levels as they progress.  Our Premium Season Pass is full of value and available for purchase with the all new in game currency, X-COIN.

[h2]Season 4 Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]New Features[/h3]
Implemented Base Building
Implemented New Map (Old map was 16km sq, New map is 64 km sq)
Added new 2-person buggy vehicle
Implemented Campaign missions system
Added rifle/smg extended mag (+15 capacity)
Added new pistol suppressor
Implemented destructible environment for trees, rocks, and more
Added Season Pass
Implemented in game premium currency system: X-coin
Implemented Season 4 skin crates and removed Season 3 skin crates
Implemented new XOID AI models replacing the old humanoid model
Implemented full character customization and clothing system
Added Clothing Skins as steam items - Clothing skins can be earned via the Season Pass
Added new craftable items
Added new pickaxe
Implemented many new buildings and assets throughout the map
Implemented slot based storage container system
Implemented new character models for Marquet, Grace, and Helicopter Pilot
Added wild deer - [i]These are experimental and still a work in progress[/i]

[h3]Equipment[/h3]
Hammer is now an equipable item and can be used as a melee.  The hammer is also used for base part management by selecting it as your equipped item and right clicking to cycle through options.  Options for base management include repairing, upgrading, setting pin codes, and destruction.  Hitting a base part with the hammer will also repair base parts consuming resources from the player’s inventory.

[h3]Player[/h3]
Dying will no longer remove experience
Respawn timer added to allow players to respawn at their sleeping bag in their base (30 second cooldown the first time you respawn, 400 second cooldown each time after your first respawn)
Reduced the amount of XP needed to level up between levels.
Level 100 now requires 500,000 XP to achieve (was 813,000)
Increased the amount of cash granted on leveling up
Removed skin crates being granted when leveling up
Player data is now saved to the server the player has joined.  Currency will still transfer globally across servers.  
Items that are on a player will stay on the server that player picked them up on unless transferred via the GI

[h3]Player Inventory[/h3]
You can now swap items position in the inventory by dragging it onto another item

[h3]Combat[/h3]
Disabled hitmarker in first person

[h3]Backpack Weights[/h3]
Increased default (no backpack weight) to 25kg (was 15kg)
Increased Satchel to 35kg (was 25kg)
Increased Small Backpack to 40kg (was 30kg)
Increased Adv. Small Backpack to 45kg (was 35kg)
Increased Medium Backpack to 48kg (was 38kg)
Increased Adv. Medium Backpack to 55kg (was 45kg)
Increased Large Backpack to 58kg (was 48kg)
Increased Adv. Large Backpack to 65kg (was 55kg)
Increased Military Backpack to 68kg (was 58kg) 
Increased Santa Backpack to 60kg (was 50kg)
Increased Adv. Military Backpack to 80kg (was 70kg)

[h3]Weapon[/h3]
Fixed an issue with double shooting effects on local players

[h3]Grouping[/h3]
Group limit increased to 6
Group tags will now hide when HUD is hidden
Added 2 new colors to group system
Added kick from group to player menu

[h3]Sights[/h3]
Increased zoomed FOV on holographic sight
Increased zoomed FOV on red dot sight

[h3]Server List[/h3]
Server list will now display the time you last played on that server

[h3]Skill Rating[/h3]
Changed default skill rating to 0. Max Skill Rating 2000

[h3]AI[/h3]
Fixed an edge-case issue of AI spawner getting stuck in respawn cycle
Removed old humanoid models and replaced with new XOIDs
Improvements to optimization of AI NPC Characters

[h3]Audio[/h3]
Increased maximum amount of sounds that can play at once (fixes sounds cutting out)
Added localized audio to specific areas of the map
Weather sounds are now reduced when under a roof

[h3]Crafting[/h3]
Tools will now automatically destroy when reaching 0 durability
Most craftable items now require you to be in proximity to a base workbench
Multiple new crafting recipes added

[h3]Throwables / Explosives[/h3]
Support for multiple placement of C4 added (5 max at a time), detonation will detonate all placed C4
C4 Will now despawn after player that placed them logs out of a server

[h3]Vendor[/h3]
Reduced level discount amount on purchasing items
Reduced level bonus for selling items
Adjustments made to most vendor items including new selling and buyback values
All items except special holiday event items can be sold to the vendor
Removed all crafting components from the vendor’s selling table
Removed AK-47, VSS, SVG, and L96-A1 from the vendor’s selling table
When selling items that are equipped to the vendor, the vendor will now buy the item that you drag to the center - Previously there was a bug where the vendor would take a duplicate item from your inventory causing people to sell the non-equipped item instead.
PVE server vendors will now only give half the amount they would normally give on PVP servers to players when selling items at the vendor
Fixed an issue causing the vendor to calculate the incorrect prices for some items

[h3]Localization[/h3]
Language options are experimental and will continue to be updated as content is updated.  Not all languages have been fully translated, however they will be over time.

[h3]Global Stash[/h3]
Global Stash disabled on PVE servers
Global Stash capacity reduced (level 1 starts at 30kg - was 100kg, level 100 maxes at 200kg - was 3000kg)

[h3]Transporter[/h3]
Increased price of riding helicopter to 500 (was 50)
Voting is now safe zone based, instead of selecting a specific path
Changed POV when flying in the helicopter

[h3]Environment[/h3]
Day/Night cycle changed to 40 minutes for daytime and 20 minutes for nighttime (was 50 minutes for daytime and 10 minutes for nighttime)

[h3]Animations[/h3]
Fixed an issue causing pistol crouch animation to show when swapped to melee

[h3]Commands[/h3]
Removed /outfit command

[h3]UI[/h3]
When dropping a split quantity in the inventory, you can now press enter to drop instead of pressing the drop button
Reduced size of squad list
Fixed an issue with markers overlapping map key
Improved player list UI
Improved crafting menu UI
Added missions UI
Improved Inventory UI

[h3]Loot[/h3]
Loot tables have been updated for the new map
Added multiple new loot tables specific to each type of XOID
Added specific loot tables to specific container types found throughout the map.
Added new ammo boxes to various areas of the map

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
Various bug fixes implemented - too many to list
Multiple optimizations for server and client performance

[h2]Final Notes[/h2]
It's been a long few weeks and we're here to support you all as a community.  We have tested everything thoroughly, but do anticipate that some bugs can and will crop up, and let's face it, there's no games out there that are 100% bug free.  If you do encounter any bugs, please be sure to submit a bug report using the following form: https://forms.gle/zNQ8VhjH7LvvaMt17

We're looking forward to a busy time for everyone, and truly hope you enjoy playing. Your feedback and ideas are what will continue to drive development and we will be reading everyone's feedback. Feel free to let us know if there's anything we can do better by joining our discord at https://discord.gg/xera and let's all have a wonderful time playing during Season 4!

Cheers,
The Spotted Kiwi Interactive Team

notes.title: An Important Update Regarding The Launch of Season 4 and Free To Play
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/4261e4cc661f89bcf8698f057eeb02e6e8e7de65.png[/img]
Greetings Survivors,

We’ve made the difficult decision to delay the launch into Free to Play that we had previously announced would be May 27th. 

We just need a little more time to test and optimize the game given the larger map and many new systems in play and expect to launch Season 4 in June.

The good news is, there’s no cause for concern as we want to make sure the game is stable and provides a user experience that meets the expectations of everyone.

For this reason, we’ll also be remaining in Early Access for a little longer after the launch of Free to Play to make sure we are able to quickly address any issues that might crop up as we scale.

We understand that you may be disappointed that we were unable to launch this coming weekend and we appreciate your patience. This delay will allow us to bring you the best possible experience, which in the long run will be better for everyone.

For the latest information and to see more sneak peaks of what we're working on, feel free to join our discord at https://discord.gg/xera.  Our team will be posting more previews of upcoming content in the #art channel.

Cheers, 
The Spotted Kiwi team

notes.title: Free To Play Announcement | Season 4 Begins May 27th!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/411ebd6b2918a9db006bb35aa97fa8f5c3c01290.png[/img]

Greetings Survivors,

After much planning and preparation, we’re excited to announce that XERA: Survival will be moving to Free to Play alongside the launch of Season 4 - with a range of new features and content. NOW you see why we’ve been so busy!

This decision will have a positive impact on the game by opening up access to a much larger audience with no barrier to entry. The community experience will improve as the server populations grow and it allows us to get more feedback from a wider variety of players to help influence the direction we develop XERA: Survival in the future. Our scalable, robust technology will allow us to grow rapidly with the increase in our audience.

We would like to extend our thanks to everyone who has supported us throughout Early Access. All those who have activated a key or purchased the game right up until the exact moment we go Free to Play and launch Season 4 will be granted The Founders Package free of charge. This will include a variety of goodies including the Full Alpha Titan Skin Set and a bundle of Season 4 Premium Skin Crates worth more than the original selling price of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/610fe8f4910a5cb83439f04ac429624cd0191385.png[/img]

We are super excited for the future, and hope you are too! Be sure to check out our most recent [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/625340/view/4954500973818215022]development blog[/url] which showcases the major features arriving with Season 4, including base building, a whole new map designed from the ground up, and more!  As always, feel free to connect with our team via [url=https://discord.gg/xera]Discord[/url] for the latest updates and sneak peeks.

[h3]FAQ:[/h3]
[b]When will XERA: Survival be hitting F2P?[/b]
The game will be available for free when we launch Season 4 on May 27th.
 
[b]Will development continue after F2P launch and the game exits Early Access?[/b]
Yes. The team has no plans to stop development of XERA: Survival. By moving to F2P, it will enable an influx of new players who can provide ideas and feedback for future updates.
 
[b]What will happen if I purchase the game before Free to Play launch or if I have purchased it in the past?[/b]
You will receive the Founders Package with unique skins and a bundle of Season 4 Premium Skin crates valued higher than the original selling price of the game.

[b]Are you ready for the influx of new players when you go F2P?[/b]
Our technology is highly scalable and we will have servers ready to spin up as needed in our locations around the world.
 
[b]Can I receive a refund?[/b]
Refunds will be granted based on Steam’s own guidelines. Remember, all owners will be receiving the full Founders Package.

Happy Xoid hunting!

The Spotted Kiwi Interactive Team

notes.title: Development Blog #5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/1f7177c88390c24d77ed017e1bdcd55302ea0ddf.png[/img]

[b]Greetings Survivors![/b]

It has been some time since we have showcased the development progress, and with everything moving so quickly, we wanted to take time to show off some of the hard work happening behind the scenes!  As many things have been changing and improving, we wanted to hold off until we had some time to showcase some upcoming features in a more polished state. Our team has been hard at work and we are very pleased with how internal testing has gone so far and are happy to share some of that progress in this development blog!

[h2]Base Building[/h2]
One of the biggest new features coming for Season 4 that we’re excited to share more information with you on, is our new base building system!

Our base building design will require resource gathering, which means we have implemented a destructible environment system that will allow for the gathering of wood, rocks, and other resources. By default Unreal Engine does not support this very well so in order to achieve a destructible environment that will scale to the size of our new map (64km2), we had to modify the engine. Resources that have been harvested will respawn after a certain amount of time, and regions on the map will be specialized in certain resources that are generated within each area.

Wood can be harvested from trees with an axe, boulders can be harvested for ores and rocks with a pickaxe. A furnace is used to smelt ores into bars, which then can be used to craft other items or upgrade your base.

We’ve overhauled our placement system which was previously used for other deployables such as sandbags and turrets. The new system includes a snapping system, which allows for base parts to easily snap together. 

Each base part will have individual health and will be destroyed if it’s supported by other base parts; for example a wall or roof that has no other supports will also be destroyed. Base parts are individually upgradable, with 3 tiers - Wood, Stone and Metal. 

The base building system is separated by two separate types of components, base parts and perimeter parts. Base parts, such as foundations, walls, floors are used to create your base. The perimeter parts, such as walls, gates and platforms are used to surround your base to add extra protection. Base parts will only snap to other base parts, and perimeter will only snap to other perimeter parts.

Other objects such as storage containers, water collectors, and more will also be available to place inside and around your base. Defense objects, such as punji sticks and turrets can also be used to protect your base against raiders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/a416919867bc562a693a9d8d5c5c3f6e658d165d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/b320f02d5e8cbf64bb8691dd7a4526a046f7b0e8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/0208bee9affeeae4deff74096f0bf9e91736c038.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/16f852efbe8aea23150feb17f936ff87ef770f3a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/00dd0a94a0b29ebde90b0fead1e3571d541f0a30.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/0216299534e4a21dc3e3ae2cdf202a70b0a64e4f.jpg[/img]
[h2]Missions / Campaigns[/h2]
One of the biggest new features for Season 4 will be the new Missions and Campaigns system.  As we talked with a lot of community members, one of the biggest challenges in the game’s current state was finding a way to give people a better sense of progression and sense of accomplishment.  By dedicating time and putting substantial work into the missions system, we hope to help address some of these concerns from the community as well as give players more ways to progress through the game and learn about features they may not be aware of.
 
The missions system has been split into 4 categories, each with varying mission types and objectives. Mission objectives will have a large variety of objectives including item collection, resource gathering, NPC / Player kills, crafting, building and more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/9da56779849fa1f23436f5a807f1be7ce09680b6.jpg[/img]
[h3]Mission System Categories[/h3]
[b]Daily -[/b] Daily missions will rotate every 24 hours. Each daily mission will give specific rewards for completing the required tasks.

[b]Vendor -[/b] Vendor missions are objectives that a vendor may ask you to complete, finishing these missions will grant vendor reputation and your vendor reputation will provide discounts for purchasing and increased buy-back values.

[b]Field -[/b] The field missions can be activated by completing events on the map, including radio towers, compounds and reactor events. These missions are optional and can be rejected if you don’t wish to complete them. For field missions, you will have a limited amount of active missions that can be progressed through at the same time.

[b]Campaign -[/b] The campaign missions will be a progressive system, which will allow players to be introduced not only to in-game mechanics, but also will challenge players by rewarding them for their time spent completing the missions and granting rewards that enable them to continue progress through the Campaign.  Campaign missions will start out very simple and increase in difficulty as you progress from one tier of missions to the next.  Rewards from these missions will include things such as gear, in game currency rewards, experience, and more.

[h2]Changes to Server Character Data[/h2]
In order to accommodate balanced cross-server gameplay we have decided to change the way characters travel across servers. You will now have a unique character on each server, with its own inventory, core stats (health etc), and location. Global stats such as currency, skill rating, experience, level and mission progression will still be shared across all servers. In order to transfer loot between servers, you must use the global stash which is in the safe settlements.

[h2]PVE Server Changes[/h2]
We’ve also made some changes to how PVE servers will work in order to create balance. Firstly, the global stash will be disabled on PVE servers - meaning you can no longer transfer loot from the PVE servers onto PVPVE servers. You must build a base to stash your loot. Raids on bases will also be disabled. Vendors in safe settlements will still be enabled, however buy-back values will be reduced by 50%. Your character’s global stats such as currency, experience, level and mission progression will still be shared across all servers. 

[h2]Character Customization[/h2]
Connor has built the new character system from the ground up, with brand new base models. You will be able customise your body type (masculine/feminine), face type, skin tone, hair style/color, eyebrow style/color, eye colour, beard style/color. 

Mikhail and Connor have also worked extensively on the clothing system and you will be able to customise character with various tops, pants/shorts, gloves and footwear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/eded7fa943586d1d9c345a13088bf280bd1faba3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/49f2f02b1b8ee3ee83c9eb5b3da4fb49c201c764.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/4b17e9a7fca838bded74e93840e0d77da806b95f.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Humanoid Design[/h2]
Connor has completely redesigned the humanoids, and they are now called Xoids! We have the all new standard Xoid, Stalker, Flamer and the Heavy. 

[h3]Standard-Xoid[/h3]
The standard humanoid will be replaced with the new updated Xoid.  Xoids will be common around the world and will spawn with various visible serial numbers which will indicate their stats - such as health and strength. Be sure to use those binoculars to see what you’re up against.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/35f4a9be68645f4c32ea6c10cb652e570f37676b.jpg[/img]

[h3]Stalker-Xoid[/h3]
The new Stalker Xoid will be replacing the old stalker humanoid, similar to the old design - it’s fast, agile and now packs some nasty swords for arms. You’ll want to look out for the blue glow as once it’s locked on - there’s no running from it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/dfa1d2d4445ad71374c16d21f65615d3774dc725.jpg[/img]

[h3]Flamer-Xoid[/h3]
The new Flamer Xoid will be replacing the exploding humanoid. Packed with a flamethrower - you’ll want to keep your distance from him! Strategically take the Flamer down around other Xoids, as it will explode and cause blast damage against other enemies. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/1dad74db96e472f18c8d2a8757e6f7b450ee38a8.jpg[/img]

[h3]Heavy-Xoid[/h3]
The new Heavy Xoid will be replacing the “Green-eyed Boss” humanoid, it’s heavy, strong and will pack a mean punch. Vulnerable areas are covered in armour, which will need to be destroyed to expose the weak points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/5ca90f055a7cf97889ae392ed9cd938706748e86.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/25e75cf3b8cf8f43ce1ace3232a11633671d77d9.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Map[/h2]
The new map is coming along really well. Erekose has created the layouts for all the new towns and cities - ready to be filled with loot and Xoids! The traditional events such as radio towers have been placed around the map, as well as the reactor compounds and regular compounds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/4dc9e4e65e8b9f6257457f2874e87393bae8a6a2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/27d12008a2adf1fda2fa0e50d0d3a98b5ee2dd46.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/7c84b4e1071cc66d4732e196bf50e0dd820d0e0a.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Buildings and Assets![/h2]
Karan has been working on a bunch of new buildings, including skyscrapers for the large city and a large mall! There’s a lot more in the works that will be in the new map as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/397169cc853e0dbeb8420e50e7ef0ec5f639ae71.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/ed76106e73d66f83ea10be3fed4804626c6fc93d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/853fa0ea59ca3d03aadb1143b3a6146076f67bdd.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29448361/cff6e6170ed1ae8a8518f1ed4aad91418c64041b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Tester Applications[/h2]
Want to get involved with the development of XERA: Survival?  This is your opportunity!  Community playtester applications are now open until May 20th!  Our ideal candidates must possess both problem solving and troubleshooting skills, as well as be able to think outside the box. Individuals must be passionate about XERA: Survival and want to help with the development process. Community playtesters must be active community members and have at least 50 hours of playtime throughout Early Access.  Applications can be submitted at [url=https://forms.gle/P69fXgJ2tZLwcrXf7]https://forms.gle/P69fXgJ2tZLwcrXf7[/url].

[h2]Closing Thoughts[/h2]
We hope that you have enjoyed reading about all of the exciting things that are coming soon and look forward to reading your feedback.  Remember, as a community driven game, we count on everyone for your feedback and suggestions as we expand the content available to all of our players.  Feel free to connect with us via our discord at [url=https://discord.gg/xera]https://discord.gg/xera[/url] and let us know your thoughts!

Cheers,
Spotted Kiwi Interactive
